tool.series: H-Carb 77 (7-flute high efficiency square end, 37 deg, non-center cutting, Ti-NAMITE-A external coolant, no chip breaker)

vendor_notes: Bhn (Brinell), HRc (Rockwell C); reduce speed and feed for materials harder than listed.
rpm = Vc x 3.82 / DC; ipm = Fz x number of flutes x rpm.
Reduce feed and Ae when finish milling (.02 x DC maximum).
Refer to the KYOCERA SGS APEX application for complete technical information.
Feed rates listed have chip thinning adjustments included where applicable.
Recommended for materials <= 45 HRc (<= 420 Bhn) (catalog series page).
Chart also offered with Ti-NAMITE-M coating and internal coolant/chip breaker variants; the same S&F chart applies to the series.
rows.notes: Chart columns mapped to diameters from the header row (1/4 3/8 1/2 5/8 3/4 1); values read from pdftotext -layout of the catalog page and checked against the rendered page image (printed page 96). Part chosen with flute length equal to the printed axial depth (2.5xD).  NCD .0845.

vendor_notes: Shop case study (one published cut with its outcome), not a chart recommendation: tool life doubled vs. the competitor 0.500" 4-flute solid end mill (95 to about 190 cycles per tool).
Application described as plunge and slot (blind) in forged 4140 with flood coolant.
rows.notes: Case study, not a chart row: fz = IPR / flutes = 0.0122 / 4 = 0.00305 in/tooth (also 39.0 / (3200 x 4) = 0.00305). The printed 419.2 SFM equals 3200 x pi x 0.5 / 12 = 419.2. Brochure gives no hardness for the forged 4140. Geometry for EDP 39871 (1/2 DC, 1-1/4 LOC, 3-1/4 OAL, .015 RE, TX coating) read from the XPR EDP table (global catalog p.30 and brochure p.5-6) and matches the case-study tool data.
